anchor = '''@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("color", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param(False, "hello\\n", id="strip ansi"),
        pytest.param(True, click.style("hello", fg="red") + "\\n", id="preserve ansi"),
    ],
)
def test_get_pager_file_nullpager_wraps_textio_stream(
'''
test = '''def test_echo_via_pager_leaves_stdout_open(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """Collecting the pager wrapper must not close the borrowed stdout.

    The wrapper is a ``TextIOWrapper`` around ``stdout.buffer``, which would
    close that buffer when finalized, breaking later output (issue #3449).
    """
    pager_out = tmp_path / "pager_out.txt"

    monkeypatch.setitem(
        click._termui_impl.os.environ,
        "PAGER",
        "click-tests-nonexistent-pager-9b3f2",
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(click._termui_impl, "isatty", lambda _: True)

    with pager_out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as text_stream:
        monkeypatch.setattr(
            click._termui_impl, "_default_text_stdout", lambda: text_stream
        )

        click.echo_via_pager("hello")
        gc.collect()

        assert not text_stream.closed
        click.echo("after", file=text_stream)

    assert pager_out.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "hello\\n\\nafter\\n"


'''
assert anchor in s
p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, test + anchor, 1), encoding="utf-8")
